assignment: Write an analyst note on whether to shift traffic to channel B.
source: For returning users A converted 90/100 and B 19/20. For new users A converted 2/20 and B 15/100. The proposed dashboard uses only overall conversions. Allocation was decided by a campaign system. Next month is expected to have equal numbers of new and returning users.

criteria.full: Computes 90% versus 95% for returning and 10% versus 15% for new users.
criteria.partial: Calculates at least one valid stratum comparison.

criteria.full: Shows the overall reversal, 92/120 versus 34/120, and explains the unequal audience mix.
criteria.partial: Notes different mixes without reconciling aggregate direction.

criteria.full: For equal mix estimates 50% for A and 55% for B and labels this a standardized descriptive scenario.
criteria.partial: Proposes weighting but gives no equal-mix comparison.

criteria.full: Recommends a stratified prospective comparison or guarded allocation using uncertainty and campaign selection.
criteria.partial: Declares a causal winner from the observed comparison.
